contract.purpose: Shared parameters for the Python collector and browser evaluator. Evaluators may implement predicates in their language but must not duplicate these values or change the documented semantics.
contract.primary_pair: Choose one pair per CoinGecko identity: the known pair with the greatest numeric liquidity_usd across all supported known contracts. Pair ordering, selected chain, and response ordering do not affect selection. A pair without numeric liquidity is not eligible.
contract.observations: Pair-specific observations are generated only from the primary pair, except SELLING_PRESSURE which is a neutral note from any known pair. Coin-level volume observation uses CoinGecko market values. Keep pair_address and dex_id on pair observations. Selling pressure is excluded from the FOMO flag count.
contract.missing_history: If prior rank, prior positive volume, current volume, or a valid prior capture timestamp is missing, momentum is INSUFFICIENT_HISTORY; do not infer a direction.
contract.momentum: rank_change is prior_rank - current_rank, so positive means rank improved. Volume moves within the inclusive noise band are flat. MIXED requires nonzero rank and volume directions that disagree. With flat volume, rank direction controls; with unchanged rank, volume direction controls.
contract.watch_only: These descriptive observations do not alter score, ordering, direction, alerts, trade gates, or trading behavior.
